name: Borgo dei Conti Resort
insider_take: This medieval borgo turned luxury resort sits majestically in the Umbrian hills, where ancient stone walls whisper tales of nobility and the surrounding vineyards produce some of Italy's most coveted wines.
whats_special: The resort occupies a genuine 14th-century village that once belonged to Italian nobility, complete with original frescoes and a private chapel. As part of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection, it features award-winning cuisine using hyperlocal ingredients and boasts panoramic views of the Valley of Perugia. The property also houses its own winery producing exceptional Sagrantino wines.
pro_tip: Book the medieval tower suite for the ultimate romantic experience – it features original stone walls, a fireplace, and 360-degree views of the Umbrian countryside that are absolutely breathtaking at sunset.
dont_miss: The truffle hunting experience with trained dogs in the nearby forests (peak season October-December), followed by a private cooking class where you'll learn to prepare traditional Umbrian dishes with your fresh finds. Also reserve time for the exclusive wine cellar tour and tasting in the ancient underground caves.
pros: Historic medieval borgo setting with authentic Umbrian architecture
Panoramic views of Perugia countryside and rolling hills
Luxury spa and wellness facilities in tranquil environment
Fine dining restaurant featuring local Umbrian cuisine
cons: Secluded countryside location requires car for city access
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
